'''DS-3-12''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[TIE pilot]] who served in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]]<ref name="CSWE" /> by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] occurred, during which the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] attempted to destroy the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> DS-3-12 was among the TIE [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who fought in the battle,<ref name="CSWE" /> which saw numerous [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] attempting to defend the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] from the Alliance [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Ultimately, the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] fighters were unsuccessful in defending the [[Space station/Legends|station]], which was destroyed in a major Alliance victory over the Empire.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:DS-3-12.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The image used by the ''A New Hope'' set of the ''Star Wars Trading Card Game'' to represent DS-3-12 was instead that of a TIE fighter previously identified as Black 4, piloted by DS-61-4.]]
The name "DS-3-12" was coined by [[Wizards of the Coast]] in the [[2002]] [[A New Hope (TCG)|''A New Hope'']] expansion of the ''[[Star Wars Trading Card Game]]''. Although the card game identified "DS-3-12" as the designation of a TIE fighter,<ref name="TCG">{{TCG|set=A New Hope|cardname=TIE Fighter DS-3-12|link=https://swtcg.com/Content/Images/Cards/ANH/TIE_Fighter_DS_3_12.webp?v=2}}</ref> [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' instead established that name as the call sign of the corresponding TIE pilot.<ref name="CSWE" /> This article assumes the latter source is correct.

Furthermore, the ''Star Wars Trading Card Game'' card for DS-3-12 uses a film still<ref name="TCG" /> of a TIE fighter destroyed by [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] during the Battle of Yavin scenes in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> That TIE fighter had previously been identified as "[[Black 4]],"<ref name="B4card">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Black 4}}</ref> and its pilot identified as "[[DS-61-4]]," in the [[1996]] ''[[A New Hope Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Decipher]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="DS614card">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=DS-61-4}}</ref> This article treats the identification of DS-3-12 by the ''Star Wars Trading Card Game'' as an error and as such avoids linking the subject to any of the onscreen TIE fighters seen in the ''A New Hope'' Battle of Yavin scenes.
